configuration.architecture: GroundingDINO with Swin-B and BERT; positive/negative prompt support
configuration.input_mode: unchanged metadata positive text label; no negative text or visual exemplars
configuration.timing_scope: Model forward including tokenization and text/image encoders
configuration.checkpoint_loading_note: The official app omits the feature_map_encoder whose call is commented out in the training model. Exclude its 38 explicitly listed checkpoint entries; load all actual inference parameters strictly.

prompt: unchanged metadata positive text label; no negative text or visual exemplars
confidence_note: P(exact count) unavailable; object scores are separate.
cost_note: No inference API calls. Compute estimate prices per-image latency only; excludes setup/idle time and is not a hosting invoice.
timing_note: Setup includes load/hash verification. Per-image latency includes image loading, preprocessing, prompt encoding, model forward, postprocessing and artifact saving. inference_seconds measures the forward path separately. First image can include a cold forward unless warmup is recorded.

setup.implementation_note: CPU uses upstream PyTorch deformable-attention fallback; no CUDA extensions compiled. CUDA requires upstream extension installation.

dataset.name: six selected FSC-147 Group 1 images
dataset.note: This mixed-split pilot is not an independent held-out evaluation for FSC-147-trained checkpoints. Gold counts are excluded from predictor inputs and result rows. FamNet receives the official exemplar boxes; text-only models do not.
